_comment: Machine-readable accepted-risk contract for the CI dependency-audit gate.
This file is the ONLY way a production advisory is allowed past the gate.
Every entry names one exact advisory, one exact package, a hard expiry, the
issue tracking its removal, and the human decision record that justifies it.
There is deliberately no wildcard advisory, no wildcard package, no
severity-threshold suppression and no blanket 'ignore' flag. Adding an entry
is a reviewed security decision, not a way to quiet CI.
The gate fails when an entry expires, when an entry no longer matches a
reported advisory (a solved advisory must have its exception deleted, not
left behind), when the package does not match, when an entry is duplicated,
when a required field is missing, or when the referenced decision record is
Expiry rule: an acceptance is invalid from 00:00 UTC on expires_on, so
2026-11-13 is the first day these entries are refused.
Scope: production dependencies only (npm audit --omit=dev). Dev/build
advisories are reported informationally and must never be listed here.
